correctness.rationale: The capacity-two weights from the original source are w=(t,1+t,1). Finite canonical multinomial counting yields the M law. Exponential-family differentiation proves strict variance monotonicity. Exact hypergeometric sampling at t=1 gives its maximum. A strictly concave Stirling functional has a unique maximizer satisfying equation (3); the explicit quadratic branch yields the √z crossover. At z=a/L² and n=L+k the exact factorial ratio is bounded termwise by a^j/[j!(j+|k|)!], proving total-variation and moment convergence to the Bessel-count distribution and the variance formula. The standalone code passes 414 independent finite-generator/limit checks; these supplement analytical proofs. No incompatible normalization or limit-order substitution was found.

value.rationale: At approximately one particle per site the rare double vacancies are constrained to appear with double occupancies; the physically natural scale z=a/L² produces a whole non-Poisson Bessel family indexed by the exact integer doping, and the thermodynamic-first scale ρ−1=O(√z) gives a separate universal square-root profile. This establishes natural and complete leading stationary defect-fluctuation laws beyond the original source’s modal statistics. The exact unique finite-site variance optimum at nontrivial fillings ties the effects together. The result is not merely a tabulation at an arbitrary size and does not purport to be a general dynamical theorem.
